purpose: pellav2 audio verdict rule (AUDIO_PELLAV2_IN_VERDICT=true), fixed on ASVspoof 2019 LA dev only
threshold_rule: threshold = 0.5, the authors' operating point (pellav2_infer.py), fixed before any scoring; the ASVspoof 2019 LA dev sample only checks it (its EER threshold is reported, not used: the scores saturate near 0 and 1, so the EER point falls anywhere in the gap between the classes); inconclusive band = the platform default UNCERTAIN_BAND (0.08), fixed in advance and not tuned on audio
decision_rule: pellav2 probability p: authentic if p < 0.4200, flagged (AI-generated) if p >= 0.5800, inconclusive otherwise; heuristic signals carry no weight

dev_sample.note: dev holds only the training attacks A01-A06; these numbers are optimistic
